evidence.reason: Within the supplied region, the docblock at lines 34-37 explicitly claims this function builds the plan "with ... the test-file stage allowlist layered onto every unit job (the restriction is ENFORCED at the staged set, not just declared by the label)." So the test-file staging restriction the comment says is layered/enforced is not applied by this function. `proposeOnly: true` mitigates harm (edits would be proposed rather than committed, per the finding), but the documented enforcement mechanism is absent, so at minimum the comments are inaccurate and likely the intended allowlist is missing. The stray duplicate `/**` at line 33 (line 32 is also `/**`) corroborates the sloppy doc block. Whether `buildSweepPlan`'s default from `unitStagePathAllowlist` actually permits non-test edits (asserted from sweep.ts, which is not supplied) cannot be independently confirmed here, but the within-file doc/code mismatch is concrete and is a genuine defect regardless of which remediation is chosen.
